helpJsHooksDescription.message: Hooks intercept browser API calls (Canvas, Audio, WebGL, etc.) to detect anti-bot fingerprinting code in real-time as the page accesses those APIs.

helpJsHooksWarning.message: Hooks must install at document_start before any page script runs — otherwise the page can save references to the original APIs before our shim is in place.

helpJsHooksTip.message: Add a target like CanvasRenderingContext2D.prototype.getImageData to detect canvas fingerprinting.

helpWindowDescription.message: Detects JavaScript objects and properties added to the window global by anti-bot scripts.

helpWindowWarning.message: Some anti-bot scripts use Symbol() keys that are not enumerable — those are harder to detect.

helpWindowTip.message: Use conditions like typeof object or exists to match against the property type.

helpUrlDescription.message: Matches URLs of loaded resources (scripts, images, network requests) against patterns.

helpUrlWarning.message: Patterns ignore upper and lower case unless you turn on Case sensitive. A pattern that is too general also matches unrelated resources, so keep it specific.

helpUrlTip.message: Use the Regex option for advanced patterns like /\/v\d+\/challenge/.

helpHeaderDescription.message: Detects HTTP request and response headers set by anti-bot middleware.

helpHeaderWarning.message: Some headers are only present on the initial request — make sure your scope includes Request.

helpCookieDescription.message: Detects cookies set by anti-bot challenges. Matches the cookie name (and optionally the value pattern).

helpCookieWarning.message: Cookie names with random suffixes (e.g. _abck-xyz123) need a regex pattern, not a literal name.

helpCookieTip.message: Use Whole Word for exact-name matches, or Regex for prefix patterns like ^datadome-.

helpContentDescription.message: Searches for text patterns inside the page HTML and inline script tags.

helpContentWarning.message: Full-page scanning can be slow on large pages. Restrict to Only check scripts if the signature is in JS code.

helpContentTip.message: Use Whole Word to avoid false positives from substrings inside larger words.

helpDomDescription.message: Detects HTML elements using CSS selectors. Fires when the matching element is present in the DOM.

helpDomWarning.message: Selectors only match elements rendered into the actual DOM — not those inside iframes or shadow roots.

helpDomTip.message: Use specific selectors like div#cf-challenge[data-ray] rather than generic ones to reduce false positives.

helpPayloadDescription.message: Monitors all HTTP POST/PUT/PATCH request bodies for text patterns.

helpPayloadWarning.message: Payload monitoring only works for requests our extension can intercept (no encrypted bodies, no opaque blobs).

helpPayloadTip.message: Combine with URL Pattern to limit matching to specific endpoints.
